name: sites
description: Agent-agnostic website building and hosting. Build, validate, package, serve, and hand off full-stack sites from any machine, through any agent.

interface.shortDescription: Build and host websites with any agent
interface.longDescription: Build, validate, package, serve, and hand off websites — landing pages, portfolios, dashboards, portals, trackers, hubs, games, and internal tools — with any agent, on any machine. The engine is fully open source (vinext, Vite, Drizzle, Tailwind, wrangler); hosting is pluggable, so finished sites go wherever their human wants them.
defaultPrompt: Build a new-hire portal for my company
Create a daily sudoku game with a leaderboard
